The fmt return width changes from64 to32 after recovery; archived Ghidra listing shows all exits pass through MOV EAX,EBX. The thunk target is independently bound by its pointer slot.
The decode_error_kind argument becomes signed32 after removing the misleading table guard; the same32 bits are passed to the existing errno decoder.
